_note: What is at a ranger station and a waypoint post, and what crews cost to run (Design tab, 'What's at a station'). basis: 'srr' = the SRR cost model's station item (an assumption set itself); 'published' = a public figure with its source; 'estimate' = ours, reasoning given. Replace with quotes. Salaries are left out of the total (team rule) and shown on their own line.

options.name: Prefab station, about 60 m²: ops room, storage, bunks for 6
Two 20 ft containers: office and bunks for 4
Shared with an existing ranger post or partner (rent)
3.2 kW voice array, about 124 dB at 100 ft
Starlink Standard
options.note: Kit and $50/month in DRC (SRR sources); speeds are Starlink's typical residential range (25-220 down, 5-20 up), not a guarantee

kit.label: Medical cache, water purification, sensor spares, charging

hours_yr.label: Working hours per crew a year

salary_usd_yr.label: Loaded cost per person a year (shown, not counted)
salary_usd_yr.note: Local ranger pay; the Trades operations-staff estimate is $30k for network engineers

boat.label: Boat + 40 hp outboard (river sites)
boat.note: Price from the SRR access kit; life and fuel use are estimates

motor_share.label: Share of trip time under motor (the rest on foot)
motor_share.note: Trips mix boat or motorbike legs with walking to speakers off the river or road

routine_yr.label: Routine visits per speaker a year

repair_yr.label: Repair visits per speaker a year (faults)
repair_yr.note: With health telemetry (TD-AUD-03) crews go only when a speaker reports a fault or misses its test

per_round.label: Speakers visited per round (one trip)
per_round.note: A crew strings nearby speakers into one round

post.label: Waypoint post: where crews stop on longer rounds (spares locker, shelter, relay, charging)

items.name: Locked shelter for spares and an overnight stop

post.note: With posts, crews run circuits of up to 24 h (overnighting at posts) instead of 8 h day trips, so fewer main stations reach every speaker
